01

Sign in

2 plates

Two fields, no Google account, no password to forget. The only screen a signed-in device never sees again.

02

Main tabs

8 plates

The seven destinations in the left rail. Everything below the top bar is the tab; the shell never changes.

03

Panels & menus

2 plates

Overlays anchored to the top bar. Both close on Escape or an outside click.

04

Modals

4 plates

Centred dialogs over a scrim. The task dialog is the densest surface in the product and the best redesign candidate.

05

Review room

5 plates

A full-screen takeover with its own chrome — media on the left, the conversation on the right. Clients see this too, without an account.

06

Other roles

9 plates

The same shell with fewer doors. A member sees only their own work; an assigner opens on Review rather than a dashboard.

07

Phone (390px)

6 plates

The rail becomes a bottom bar and tables become card lists. Same code, no separate mobile build.

08

Dark theme

3 plates

One token block swaps the whole palette. Anything new has to work on both grounds.
